about:
Sun Driven Solar operates from Boise, Idaho, providing residential solar and battery storage services to homeowners in the region. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed in available sources.

The firm specializes in solar photovoltaic and battery system installations, including new system design, battery storage integration, system expansions, and ongoing maintenance. Its process begins with an in-depth review of a home's sun exposure and historical energy consumption to produce a customized report outlining options to offset grid usage with solar-plus-storage configurations.

Sun Driven Solar serves residential customers seeking to reduce electricity costs and increase energy resilience. Its services address homeowners looking for complete solar installations, retrofit battery additions to existing arrays, and long-term system upkeep.

The company emphasizes dependable execution and a consultative approach, positioning itself as a long-term partner for sustainable energy rather than a one-time installer.
